speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling
text: asked the Minister for Health what are the key drivers of cost increases in healthcare and what is the target to keep cost increases in the next five years to a publicly announced range.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Older patients tend to have more co-morbidities and complications, requiring more medical attention, more medications, procedures and longer hospital stays.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: So, it is almost a doubling of the number of days of stay.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Therefore, as we grow older, we are likely to spend more on healthcare.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: And collectively, as we have increasingly more older persons in our population, our overall expenditure on healthcare will also rise correspondingly.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Second, with medical advancement, new treatments will become available.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Older treatments that were less costly may now be replaced by better but more costly new treatments.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These advances can improve life spans and the quality of life, but they come at a price.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Previously, when such procedures – this kind of total knee replacements – were not widely available, elderly suffering from knee conditions would have to bear with poor mobility, which can affect their quality of life.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Healthcare workers who do important work, must be appropriately recognised and remunerated.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Eventually, increases in manpower cost will translate into higher overall healthcare cost.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: While these factors are likely to put pressure on healthcare cost, we can work together to moderate the increases to ensure our healthcare system remains affordable and sustainable.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Managing healthcare cost has been a key priority of MOH.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The three Beyonds – Beyond Healthcare to Health, Beyond Hospital to Community and Beyond Quality to Value – are key strategic planks that guide the transformation of our healthcare system to one that is future-ready and sustainable.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: By looking after our health, we can avoid or delay the need for healthcare, reduce our healthcare bill, and more importantly, we can enjoy a better quality of life.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For example, we declared the War on Diabetes, to get all of us, to not only better manage our chronic conditions, but to also choose healthier meals and more active lifestyles.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We enhanced Screen for Life subsidies to encourage Singaporeans to go for regular health screenings, to detect and manage health conditions early.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These efforts will help us to live long and live well, and avoid future complications that will require much more costly healthcare services.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: When we go beyond Hospital to the Community, we ensure that we do not overuse expensive hospital care when we do not need it.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We have therefore invested in raising capacity and capability in the primary care and the intermediate and long-term care sectors, so as to provide care that better meet the needs of patients.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Moving Beyond Quality to Value calls for all of us to be better informed and to be more discerning in how we consume healthcare.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Are we stretching our healthcare dollars by choosing therapies that are cost-effective and well supported by clinical evidence?

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: So, we established the Agency for Care Effectiveness or ACE to evaluate healthcare technologies and issue guidances on drugs and other technologies to share with both the public and private healthcare sectors.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Agency for Logistics Procurement and Supply or ALPS was set up to aggregate demand and secure better prices for drugs and other supplies, as well as streamline and reduce supply chain costs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This complements MOH's annual publication of hospital bill sizes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Both the bill size publication and fee benchmarks are available at the MOH website.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: To help patients pay for the remaining share of their costs, we have MediShield Life and MediSave.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For Singaporeans who need extra help, there is MediFund.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: So, this constitutes our S plus 3M Framework – subsidies plus 3Ms.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: As I have laid out, while there are measures we can take to manage healthcare cost, there is unfortunately, no silver bullet.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We will need a sustained effort over many years and for all stakeholders to play their part and do so together.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We will ensure that Singaporeans will always have access to good quality healthcare that is appropriate and affordable.
